messages:
Alex K: Heads up — vendor just updated lead times for the 80GB A100 batch. Supplier says 3–5 weeks instead of 2. Quote: https://vendor.example.com/po/49872 :grimacing:
Samira G: Ugh. Which POs affected?
Alex K: POs: PO-49872, PO-50102. Both for Dedicated cluster replenish.
Jordan L: Any option for partial ship? We can accept 8/16 card split?
SupplyVendorBot: Vendor portal update: PO-49872 status=Backordered, est-ship=2026-04-18, split-shipment=Y, RMA-policy=standard.
Maria P: Ask them to split and send what's available. We have nodes in staging that can go live.
Samira G: Also need RMA turnaround for DOA units — last time was 21 days incl customs. Can they expedite RMAs under warranty?
Vendor Rep: Hi all — we can split PO-49872: 40 units ship next week, remaining in ~3 weeks. RMA SLA: expedited 7–10 business days if we do advance replacement (charges apply for shipping/insurance). Can we confirm shipping address and customs docs? Tracking will be TRK-ALB-8675309.
Alex K: Confirmed staging address: Redwood DC2 (customs CN23 on invoice). Will accept 40 unit split. Please send proforma for shipping costs.
Jordan L: Any change to unit pricing for split? We need to forecast cost.
Vendor Rep: No price change for split shipments. Shipping fee estimate: $3,200 for air express (40 units), $800 for customs brokerage. If expedite RMA add $120 per unit.
Maria P: Can we route some to EU region to avoid long US customs hold? Which SKUs are region-compatible?
Vendor Rep: 80GB A100 are region-agnostic but warranty transfer may require registration. We can route 16 units to eu-ams warehouse (ETA 10 days). Need PO amendment.
Samira G: Action items: Alex to sign amendment, Ops to open PO change request, Maria to confirm which nodes get EU units. Who will handle customs invoice?
Ops - Colin: I'll handle customs for US shipments, Maria handle EU docs.
Alex K: Alex uploaded amendment signed: https://vendor.example.com/amend/49872/accept
SupplyVendorBot: RMA created: `RMA-83721` for 4 DOA GPUs from recent batch. Vendor rep, please confirm advance replacement vs repair.
Vendor Rep: `RMA-83721` acknowledged. We recommend advance replacement; will dispatch 4 units with TRK-ALB-8675310, ETA 3 days if using air. Please provide serials and failure photos.
Jordan L: Serial list sent in DM to ops@albatross-supply earlier today.
Maria P: Budget note — expedite add-on will cost ~ $480 extra on RMA (4 * $120). Approve?
Samira G: Approve.
Alex K: Thanks. Any other blockers?
Vendor Rep: Nothing else. Will update tracking and PO amendments by EOD.
Samira G: Great. Marking as in-flight. :thumbsup:
